beats.say: Sir Patrick Stewart was born in 1940.
He was knighted by Queen Elizabeth II for his services to drama in 2010.
His final film performance was in Avengers: Doomsday, released in 2026.
Why did he have such a long and successful career?
It was his dedication to his craft and his ability to connect with audiences.
His incredible legacy lives on whenever viewers turn on his finest roles.
What was your favourite Patrick Stewart role?

facts: Sir Patrick Stewart was born on 13 July 1940 in Mirfield in the West Riding of Yorkshire.
Avengers: Doomsday, part of the Marvel Cinematic Universe from 2022 to 2026, was his final film performance.
He was knighted by Queen Elizabeth II for his services to drama in 2010.
